title: [29.X]-[CH] SEPA XML Files should append the Address 1 + '' + Address 2 fields under <PstlAdr><StrtNm> node if we use "Address 2" as Building Number for QR-Bills
summary: SEPA XML export for QR-Bills in Switzerland now concatenates Address 1 and Address 2 fields in the street name node when Address 2 is used as a building number.
key_points: SEPA XML structure updated to append Address 2 as building number to Address 1 in street name field
Applies specifically to Swiss QR-Bill payment exports
Changes affect the Payment Export Data table
Added test coverage for new export behavior in Swiss SEPA tests
